title: The W-Operator: A Volterra Fractional Time Operator with Sharp Bernstein Threshold and Regularized Memory
summary: We introduce a new two-parameter fractional time operator with Volterra structure, denoted by ${}^{W}D_{t}^{α,β}$, defined through the Laplace symbol \[ Φ_{α,β}(s) = \frac{s^α}{\bigl(1+(1-α)s^{α-1}\bigr)^β}, \qquad 0 0$. Nevertheless, by a direct complete-monotonicity argument on $Φ'_{α,β}$, we prove the exact Bernstein threshold \[ Φ_{α,β}\in\mathcal{BF} \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad 0\leβ\le1. \] where $\mathcal{BF}$ denotes the class of Bernstein functions \noindent For $β>1$, the Bernstein property fails by a low-frequency asymptotic convexity obstruction.
